name: nf-income-tax
description: Classify Norfolk Island individual income tax residence, income and deductions before applying the Australian ordinary personal rates for 2026–27. Covers territorial application, worldwide income, full-year and part-year thresholds, the conditional standard work-expense deduction, the low income tax offset, and Norfolk zone offset conditions. Use for Norfolk personal tax, resident rates, work deductions, mainland moves or zone offset questions. Includes statutory citations, fictional computations, classification patterns and reviewer checks. This source-cited reference preserves unresolved Medicare, other offsets, special income and filing requirements; it does not complete an individual return or the country pack.
